effect.short_effect: Transfers 1/4 of the user’s max HP into a doll, protecting the user from further damage or status changes until it breaks.
effect.effect:
Transfers 1/4 the user’s max HP into a doll that absorbs damage and causes most negative move effects to fail.  If the user leaves the field, the doll will vanish.  If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail.

The doll takes damage as normal, using the user’s stats and types, and will break when its HP reaches zero.  Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed.  Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal.  Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the doll’s HP does not influence any move.

The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching.  The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect.  Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate.

Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche, Counter, or a Rowap Berry.  Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block.  Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal.

It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed, and Yawn.  A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep.

The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist.  If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked.

Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll.

The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes.

The doll is passed on by Baton Pass.  It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation.

All other effects work as normal.

flavor_text.ko: 자신의 HP를 조금 깎아서 분신을 만든다. 분신은 자신의 대타가 된다.

The target cannot recover its item with Recycle.

effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits two to five times in a row.
flavor_text.ko: 단단한 뼈로 상대를 세게 때려서 공격한다. 2-5회 동안 연속으로 쓴다.

effect.short_effect: Ensures that the user’s next move will hit the target.
effect.effect:
If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit.  This move itself also ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

One-hit KO moves are also guaranteed to hit, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target.  This effect also allows the user to hit Pokémon that are off the field due to moves such as Dig or Fly.

If the target uses Detect or Protect while under the effect of this move, the user is not guaranteed to hit, but has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

flavor_text.en: The user takes sure aim at the target. This ensures the user's next move does not miss that target.
flavor_text.ko: 조준을 잘 맞춰 다음 공격이 반드시 상대에게 명중하도록 한다.

effect.short_effect: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random.  After the last hit, the user becomes confused.

Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

flavor_text.en: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
flavor_text.ko: 2-3턴 동안 마구 난동 부려서 공격한다. 난동 부린 뒤에는 혼란에 빠진다.

effect.short_effect: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns.
effect.effect:
Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns.  Pokémon that are not Ground, Rock, or Steel take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn.  Every Rock Pokémon’s original Special Defense is raised by 50% for the duration of this effect.

Solar Beam’s power is halved.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis only heal 1/4 the user’s max HP.

flavor_text.en: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to damage all Pokémon except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types.
flavor_text.ko: 5턴 동안 모래바람을 일으켜 바위 땅, 강철타입 이외의 상대에게 데미지를 준다. 바위타입의 특수방어가 올라간다.

effect.short_effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

flavor_text.en: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
flavor_text.ko: 양분을 흡수하여 공격한다. 입힌 데미지의 절반에 해당하는 HP를 회복할 수 있다.

effect.short_effect: Prevents the user’s HP from lowering below 1 this turn.
effect.effect:
The user’s HP cannot be lowered below 1 by any means for the remainder of this turn.

If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

flavor_text.en: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.
flavor_text.ko: 공격을 받아도 HP를 반드시 1만큼은 남긴다. 연속으로 쓰면 실패하기 쉽다.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.
effect.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

flavor_text.en: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.
flavor_text.ko: 귀엽게 바라보고 방심을 유도하여 상대의 공격을 크게 떨어뜨린다.

effect.short_effect: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, resetting after five turns.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User is forced to use this move for five turns.  Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends.  If this move misses or becomes unusable, the lock-in ends.

If the user has used Defense Curl since entering the field, this move has double power.

flavor_text.en: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. This attack becomes more powerful each time it hits.
flavor_text.ko: 5턴 동안 구르기를 반복하여 공격한다. 기술이 맞을 때마다 위력이 올라간다.

effect.short_effect: Cannot lower the target’s HP below 1.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Will not reduce the target’s HP below 1.

flavor_text.en: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
flavor_text.ko: 상대의 HP가 반드시 1만 남도록 조절하여 공격한다.

effect.short_effect: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages and confuses the target.
effect.effect: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages, then confuses it.  If the target’s Attack cannot be raised by two stages, the confusion is not applied.

flavor_text.en: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.
flavor_text.ko: 상대를 화내게 해서 혼란시킨다. 분노로 상대의 공격은 크게 올라가 버린다.

effect.short_effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.
effect.effect: Heals the user for half its max HP.

flavor_text.en: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP.
flavor_text.ko: 자신의 최대 HP 절반을 회복한다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to paralyze the target.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
flavor_text.ko: 전기를 둘러 상대에게 돌진하여 공격한다. 마비 상태로 만들 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, maxing out after five turns.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power doubles after every time this move is used, whether consecutively or not, maxing out at 16x.  If this move misses or the user leaves the field, power resets.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks by slashing the target with scythes, claws, or the like. This attack becomes more powerful if it hits in succession.
flavor_text.ko: 낫이나 발톱 등으로 상대를 베어 공격한다. 연속으로 맞히면 위력이 올라간다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense one stage.

flavor_text.en: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also boost the user's Defense stat.
flavor_text.ko: 단단한 날개를 상대에게 부딪쳐서 공격한다. 자신의 방어가 올라갈 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
effect.effect:
The target cannot switch out normally.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.  This effect ends when the user leaves the field.

The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell.

Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

flavor_text.en: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
flavor_text.ko: 빨려 들어갈 것 같은 까만 눈빛으로 가만히 응시하여 상대를 배틀에서 도망갈 수 없게 한다.

effect.short_effect: Target falls in love if it has the opposite gender, and has a 50% chance to refuse attacking the user.
effect.effect: Causes the target to fall in love with the user, giving it a 50% chance to do nothing each turn.  If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail.  If either Pokémon leaves the field, this effect ends.

flavor_text.en: If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will sometimes be unable to use its moves.
flavor_text.ko: 수컷은 암컷을 암컷은 수컷을 유혹하여 헤롱헤롱하게 만든다. 상대가 기술을 쓰기 어려워진다.

effect.short_effect: Randomly uses one of the user’s other three moves.  Only works if the user is sleeping.
effect.effect:
Only usable if the user is sleeping.  Randomly selects and uses one of the user’s other three moves.  Use of the selected move requires and costs 0 PP.

This move will not select Assist, Bide, Bounce, Chatter, Copycat, Dig, Dive, Fly, Focus Punch, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, Shadow Force, Skull Bash, Sky Attack, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Solar Beam, Razor Wind, or Uproar.

If the selected move requires a recharge turn—i.e., one of Blast Burn, Frenzy Plant, Giga Impact, Hydro Cannon, Hyper Beam, Roar of Time, or Rock Wrecker—and the user is still sleeping next turn, then it’s forced to use this move again and pay another PP for the recharge turn.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

flavor_text.en: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.
flavor_text.ko: 자신이 배운 기술 중 하나를 무작위로 날린다. 자신이 잠들어 있을 때만 쓸 수 있다.

effect.short_effect: Cures the entire party of major status effects.
effect.effect: Removes major status effects and confusion from every Pokémon in the user’s party.

flavor_text.en: The user makes a soothing bell chime to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.
flavor_text.ko: 기분 좋은 방울소리를 들려주어 같은 편 전원의 상태 이상을 회복한다.

effect.short_effect: Power increases with happiness, up to a maximum of 102.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power increases with happiness, given by `happiness * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102.  Power bottoms out at 1.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Randomly inflicts damage with power from 40 to 120 or heals the target for 1/4 its max HP.
effect.effect:
Randomly uses one of the following effects.

Effect                                             | Chance
-------------------------------------------------- | -----:
Inflicts regular damage with 40 power  |    40%
Inflicts regular damage with 80 power  |    30%
Inflicts regular damage with 120 power |    10%
Heals the target for 1/4 its max HP    |    20%

On average, this move inflicts regular damage with 52 power and heals the target for 1/20 its max HP.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. The gift restores HP sometimes, however.
flavor_text.ko: 덫을 설치한 상자를 상대에게 건네어 공격한다. HP가 회복돼버릴 때도 있다.

effect.short_effect: Power increases as happiness decreases, up to a maximum of 102.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power increases inversely with happiness, given by `(255 - happiness) * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102.  Power bottoms out at 1.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Protects the user’s field from major status ailments and confusion for five turns.
effect.effect:
Protects Pokémon on the user’s side of the field from major status effects and confusion for five turns.  Does not cancel existing ailments.  This effect remains even if the user leaves the field.

If Yawn is used while this move is in effect, it will immediately fail.

Defog used by an opponent will end this effect.

This effect does not prevent the confusion caused by Outrage, Petal Dance, or Thrash.

flavor_text.en: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.
flavor_text.ko: 5턴 동안 이상한 힘의 보호를 받아 상태 이상이 되지 않는다.

effect.short_effect: Sets the user’s and targets’s HP to the average of their current HP.
effect.effect:
Changes the user’s and target’s remaining HP to the average of their current remaining HP.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.  This effect does not count as inflicting damage for other moves and effects that respond to damage taken.

This effect fails against a Substitute.

flavor_text.en: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally splits the combined HP between the target and itself.
flavor_text.ko: 자신의 HP와 상대의 HP를 합친 것을 자신과 상대가 사이좋게 나눈다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to burn the target.  Lets frozen Pokémon thaw themselves.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to burn the target.  Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

flavor_text.en: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. This may also leave the target with a burn.
flavor_text.ko: 신비한 불꽃으로 상대를 태워서 공격한다. 화상 상태로 만들 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Power varies randomly from 10 to 150.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power is selected at random between 10 and 150, with an average of 71:

Magnitude | Power | Chance
--------: | ----: | -----:
        4 |    10 |     5%
        5 |    30 |    10%
        6 |    50 |    20%
        7 |    70 |    30%
        8 |    90 |    20%
        9 |   110 |    10%
       10 |   150 |     5%

This move has double power against Pokémon currently underground due to Dig.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to confuse the target.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.
flavor_text.ko: 혼신의 힘으로 펀치를 날려서 공격한다. 상대를 반드시 혼란시킨다.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.en: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.
flavor_text.ko: 단단하고 훌륭한 뿔로 마음껏 상대를 꿰찔러서 공격한다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to paralyze the target.

flavor_text.en: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
flavor_text.ko: 굉장한 숨결을 상대에게 내뿜어 공격한다. 마비 상태로 만들 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Allows the trainer to switch out the user and pass effects along to its replacement.
effect.effect:
User switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party.  Stat changes, confusion, and persistent move effects are passed along to the replacement Pokémon.

The following move effects are passed:

* Aqua Ring
* both the user’s and target’s effect of Block, Mean Look, and Spider Web
* the curse effect of Curse
* Embargo
* Focus Energy or an activated Lansat Berry
* Gastro Acid
* Ingrain
* being sapped by Leech Seed
* being targeted by Lock-On or Mind Reader
* Magnet Rise
* Perish Song’s counter
* Power Trick
* Substitute; the doll’s HP is unchanged

The replacement Pokémon does not trigger effects that respond to Pokémon switching in.

flavor_text.en: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.
flavor_text.ko: 교대 포켓몬과 바뀐다. 능력 변화는 바뀐 포켓몬이 그대로 이어받는다.

effect.short_effect: Forces the target to repeat its last used move every turn for 2 to 6 turns.
effect.effect:
The next 4–8 times (selected at random) the target attempts to move, it is forced to repeat its last used move.  If the selected move allows the trainer to select a target, an opponent will be selected at random each turn.  If the target is prevented from using the selected move by some other effect, Struggle will be used instead.  This effect ends if the selected move runs out of PP.

If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if it does not know the selected move, or if the selected move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail.  If the target’s last used move was Encore, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Struggle, or Transform, this move will fail.

flavor_text.en: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.
flavor_text.ko: 상대에게 앵콜시킨 기술을 3번 연속으로 쓰게 한다.

effect.short_effect: Has double power against, and can hit, Pokémon attempting to switch out.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target attempts to switch out this turn before the user acts, this move hits the target before it leaves and has double power.

This effect can still hit a Pokémon that switches out when it has a Substitute up or when an ally has used Follow Me.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Frees the user from binding moves, removes Leech Seed, and blows away Spikes.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Removes Leech Seed from the user, frees the user from Bind, Clamp, Fire Spin, Magma Storm, Sand Tomb, Whirlpool, and Wrap, and clears Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the user’s side of the field.  If this move misses or has no effect, its effect doesn’t activate.

flavor_text.en: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
flavor_text.ko: 회전해서 상대를 공격한다. 조이기, 김밥말이, 씨뿌리기 등을 날려버린다. 자신의 스피드도 오른다.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.
effect.effect: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.

flavor_text.en: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.
flavor_text.ko: 향기로 상대의 회피율을 크게 떨어뜨린다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

flavor_text.en: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
flavor_text.ko: 단단한 꼬리로 상대를 힘껏 쳐서 공격한다. 상대의 방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack one stage.

flavor_text.en: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also boost the user's Attack stat.
flavor_text.ko: 강철의 발톱으로 상대를 베어 갈라 공격한다. 자신의 공격이 올라갈 때도 있다.

effect.short_effect: Never misses.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.
flavor_text.ko: 상대보다 나중에 공격한다. 그 대신 자신의 공격은 반드시 명중한다.

effect.short_effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.  Affected by weather.
effect.effect:
Heals the user for half its max HP.

During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

flavor_text.en: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
flavor_text.ko: 자신의 HP를 회복한다. 날씨에 따라 회복량이 변한다.

effect.short_effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.  Affected by weather.
effect.effect:
Heals the user for half its max HP.

During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

flavor_text.en: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
flavor_text.ko: 자신의 HP를 회복한다. 날씨에 따라 회복량이 변한다.

effect.short_effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.  Affected by weather.
effect.effect:
Heals the user for half its max HP.

During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

flavor_text.en: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
flavor_text.ko: 자신의 HP를 회복한다. 날씨에 따라 회복량이 변한다.

effect.short_effect: Power and type depend upon user’s IVs.  Power can range from 30 to 70.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power and type are determined by the user’s IVs.

Power is given by `x * 40 / 63 + 30`.  `x` is obtained by arranging bit 1 from the IV for each of Special Defense, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, Attack, and HP in that order.  (Bit 1 is 1 if the IV is of the form `4n + 2` or `4n + 3`.  `x` is then 64 * Special Defense IV bit 1, plus 32 * Special Attack IV bit 1, etc.)

Power is always between 30 and 70, inclusive.  Average power is 49.5.

Type is given by `y * 15 / 63`, where `y` is similar to `x` above, except constructed from bit 0.  (Bit 0 is 1 if the IV is odd.)  The result is looked up in the following table.

Value | Type
----: | --------
    0 | Fighting
    1 | Flying
    2 | Poison
    3 | Ground
    4 | Rock
    5 | Bug
    6 | Ghost
    7 | Steel
    8 | Fire
    9 | Water
   10 | Grass
   11 | Electric
   12 | Psychic
   13 | Ice
   14 | Dragon
   15 | Dark

This move thus cannot be Normal.  Most other types have an equal 1/16 chance to be selected, given random IVs.  However, due to the flooring used here, Bug, Fighting, and Grass appear 5/64 of the time, and Dark only 1/64 of the time.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

flavor_text.en: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
flavor_text.ko: 양손으로 당수를 상대에게 힘껏 쳐서 공격한다. 급소에 맞기 쉽다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to make each target flinch.

If the target is under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, this move will hit with double power.

flavor_text.en: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.
flavor_text.ko: 회오리를 일으켜 상대를 끌어들여 공격한다. 상대를 풀죽게 만들 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Changes the weather to rain for five turns.
effect.effect:
Changes the weather to rain for five turns, during which Water moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Fire moves inflict half damage.

If the user is holding Damp Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

Thunder has 100% accuracy.  If the target has used Detect or Protect, Thunder has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

Solar Beam has half power.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP.

Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed.

Pokémon with Forecast become Water.

Pokémon with Dry Skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with Hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with Rain Dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.

flavor_text.en: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.
flavor_text.ko: 5턴 동안 비를 내리게 해서 물타입 기술의 위력을 올린다. 불꽃타입의 위력은 떨어진다.

effect.short_effect: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.
effect.effect:
Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which Fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Water moves inflict half damage.

If the user is holding Heat Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

Pokémon cannot become frozen.

Thunder has 50% accuracy.

Solar Beam skips its charge turn.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP.

Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed.

Pokémon with Forecast become Fire.

Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects.

Pokémon with Flower Gift change form; every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%.

Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn.

Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn.

flavor_text.en: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.
flavor_text.ko: 5턴 동안 햇살을 강하게 해서 불꽃타입 기술의 위력을 올린다. 물타입의 위력은 떨어진다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

flavor_text.en: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
flavor_text.ko: 날카로운 이빨로 상대를 깨물어 부숴서 공격한다. 상대의 방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last special hit it took.
effect.effect:
Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a special move this turn.  Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user.  If there is no eligible target, this move will fail.  Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

flavor_text.en: A retaliatory attack that counters any special move, inflicting double the damage taken.
flavor_text.ko: 상대에게 받은 특수공격의 데미지를 2배로 만들어 그 상대에게 돌려준다.

effect.short_effect: Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s.
effect.effect:
Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

flavor_text.en: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
flavor_text.ko: 자신에게 암시를 걸어서 능력 변화 상태를 상대와 똑같은 상태로 만든다.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.en: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
flavor_text.ko: 눈에 보이지 않는 굉장한 속도로 상대에게 돌진하여 공격한다. 반드시 선제공격을 할 수 있다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also boost all the user's stats at once.
flavor_text.ko: 원시의 힘으로 공격한다. 자신의 모든 능력이 오를 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
flavor_text.ko: 까만 그림자의 덩어리를 내던져서 공격한다. 상대의 특수방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Hits the target two turns later.
effect.effect:
Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one.  This move cannot score a critical hit.  If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead.  Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted.  No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn.

This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.

If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail.  However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection.

The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

flavor_text.en: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.
flavor_text.ko: 기술을 사용한 2턴 뒤에 상대에게 염동력의 덩어리를 보내어 공격한다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
flavor_text.ko: 펀치로 공격한다. 상대의 방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle and inflicts 1/16 its max HP in damage for 2-5 turns.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.  The user continues to use other moves during this time.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.

If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

flavor_text.en: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
flavor_text.ko: 세차게 소용돌이치는 물속에 4-5턴 동안 상대를 가두어 공격한다.

effect.short_effect: Hits once for every conscious Pokémon the trainer has.
effect.effect:
Inflicts typeless regular damage.  Every Pokémon in the user’s party, excepting those that have fainted or have a major status effect, attacks the target.  Calculated stats are ignored; the base stats for the target and assorted attackers are used instead.  The random factor in the damage formula is not used.  Dark Pokémon still get STAB.

This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.

flavor_text.en: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.
flavor_text.ko: 같은 편 전원이 공격한다. 동료 포켓몬이 많을수록 기술의 공격 횟수가 증가한다.

effect.short_effect: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle.  Causes the target to flinch.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Causes the target to flinch.  Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field.

flavor_text.en: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.
flavor_text.ko: 선제공격으로 상대를 풀죽게 한다. 배틀에 나가서 바로 쓰지 않으면 성공할 수 없다.

effect.short_effect: Forced to use this move for several turns.  Pokémon cannot fall asleep in that time.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User is forced to use this move for 2–5 turns, selected at random.  All Pokémon on the field wake up, and none can fall to sleep until the lock-in ends.

Pokémon cannot use Rest during this effect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.
flavor_text.ko: 3턴 동안 소란 피워 공격한다. 그동안은 아무도 잠들지 않게 된다.

effect.short_effect: Stores energy up to three times for use with Spit Up and Swallow.
effect.effect:
Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.  Stores energy for use with Spit Up and Swallow.  Up to three levels of energy can be stored, and all are lost if the user leaves the field.  Energy is still stored even if the stat boosts cannot be applied.

If the user uses Baton Pass, the stat boosts are passed as normal, but the stored energy is not.

flavor_text.en: The user stores power and boosts its Defense and Sp. Def stats. This move can be used up to three times.
flavor_text.ko: 힘을 비축해서 자신의 방어와 특수방어를 올린다. 최대 3회까지 비축할 수 있다.

effect.short_effect: Power is 100 times the amount of energy Stockpiled.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Power is equal to 100 times the amount of energy stored by Stockpile.  Ignores the random factor in the damage formula.  Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used.  If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

flavor_text.en: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move's power.
flavor_text.ko: 비축된 힘을 상대에게 부딪쳐서 공격한다. 비축된 만큼 위력이 올라간다.

effect.short_effect: Recovers 1/4 HP after one Stockpile, 1/2 HP after two Stockpiles, or full HP after three Stockpiles.
effect.effect: Heals the user depending on the amount of energy stored by Stockpile: 1/4 its max HP after one use, 1/2 its max HP after two uses, or fully after three uses.  Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used.  If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.

flavor_text.en: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more power is stored, the more HP is restored.
flavor_text.ko: 비축된 힘을 꿀꺽해서 자신의 HP를 회복한다. 비축된 만큼 회복한다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to burn the target.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave them with a burn.
flavor_text.ko: 뜨거운 숨결을 상대에게 내뿜어 공격한다. 화상 상태로 만들 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Changes the weather to a hailstorm for five turns.
effect.effect:
Changes the weather to hail for five turns, during which non-Ice Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn.

If the user is holding Icy Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

Blizzard has 100% accuracy.  If the target has used Detect or Protect, Blizzard has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP.

Pokémon with Snow Cloak are exempt from this effect’s damage.

flavor_text.en: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.
flavor_text.ko: 5턴 동안 싸라기눈을 내리게 해서 얼음타입이 아닌 포켓몬 모두에게 데미지를 준다.

effect.short_effect: Prevents the target from using the same move twice in a row.
effect.effect:
Prevents the target from attempting to use the same move twice in a row.  When the target leaves the field, this effect ends.

If the target is forced to attempt a repeated move due to Choice Band, Choice Scarf, Choice Specs, Disable, Encore, Taunt, only having PP remaining for one move, or any other effect, the target will use Struggle instead.  The target is then free to use the forced move next turn, as it didn’t use that move this turn.

flavor_text.en: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
flavor_text.ko: 상대에게 트집을 잡아서 똑같은 기술을 2회 연속으로 쓸 수 없게 한다.

effect.short_effect: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage and confuses the target.
effect.effect: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage, then confuses it.

flavor_text.en: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also boosts the target's Sp. Atk stat.
flavor_text.ko: 상대를 부추겨서 혼란시킨다. 동시에 상대의 특수공격도 올라가 버린다.

effect.short_effect: Burns the target.
effect.effect: Burns the target.

flavor_text.en: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.
flavor_text.ko: 으스스하고 괴상한 불꽃을 쏘아 상대를 화상 상태로 만든다.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages.  User faints.
effect.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages.  User faints.

flavor_text.en: The user faints. In return, the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.
flavor_text.ko: 자신은 기절하게 되지만 그 대신 상대의 공격과 특수공격을 크게 떨어뜨린다.

effect.short_effect: Power doubles if user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, this move has double power.

flavor_text.en: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.
flavor_text.ko: 자신이 독, 마비, 화상 상태일 때 날리면 기술의 위력이 2배가 된다.

effect.short_effect: If the user takes damage before attacking, the attack is canceled.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the user takes damage this turn before hitting, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

flavor_text.en: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.
flavor_text.ko: 정신력을 높여 펀치를 날린다. 기술을 쓰기 전에 공격을 받으면 실패한다.

effect.short_effect: If the target is paralyzed, inflicts double damage and cures the paralysis.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is paralyzed, this move has double power, and the target is cured of its paralysis.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Redirects the target’s single-target effects to the user for this turn.
effect.effect:
Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user.  If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target.

This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain.

If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

flavor_text.en: The user draws attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user.
flavor_text.ko: 자신에게 주목시켜 상대로부터의 공격을 모두 자신에게 향하게 한다.

effect.short_effect: Uses a move which depends upon the terrain.
effect.effect:
Uses another move chosen according to the terrain.

Terrain                   | Selected move
------------------------- | ------------------
Building                  | Tri Attack
Cave                      | Rock Slide
Deep water                | Hydro Pump
Desert                    | Earthquake
Grass                     | Seed Bomb
Mountain                  | Rock Slide
Road                      | Earthquake
Shallow water             | Hydro Pump
Snow                      | Blizzard
Tall grass                | Seed Bomb
Electric Terrain | Thunderbolt
Grassy Terrain   | Energy Ball
Misty Terrain    | Moonblast

In Pokémon Battle Revolution:

Terrain        | Selected move
-------------- | ------------------
Courtyard      | Tri Attack
Crystal        | Rock Slide
Gateway        | Hydro Pump
Magma          | Rock Slide
Main Street    | Tri Attack
Neon           | Tri Attack
Stargazer      | Rock Slide
Sunny Park     | Seed Bomb
Sunset         | Earthquake
Waterfall      | Seed Bomb

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

flavor_text.en: This attack makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.
flavor_text.ko: 자연의 힘으로 공격한다. 사용하는 장소에 따라 나오는 기술이 변화한다.

effect.short_effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage.  User’s Electric moves have doubled power next turn.
effect.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage.  If the user uses an Electric move next turn, its power will be doubled.

flavor_text.en: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
flavor_text.ko: 다음 턴에 쓸 전기타입 기술의 위력을 올린다. 자신의 특수방어도 올라간다.

effect.short_effect: For the next few turns, the target can only use damaging moves.
effect.effect:
Target is forced to only use damaging moves for the next 3–5 turns, selected at random.  Moves that select other moves not known in advance do not count as damaging.

Assist, Copycat, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, and Sleep Talk do not directly inflict damage and thus may not be used.

Bide, Counter, Endeavor, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat are allowed.

flavor_text.en: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.
flavor_text.ko: 상대를 화나게 한다. 3턴 동안 상대는 데미지를 주는 기술밖에 쓸 수 없게 된다.

effect.short_effect: Ally’s next move inflicts half more damage.
effect.effect:
Boosts the power of the target’s moves by 50% until the end of this turn.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

flavor_text.en: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.
flavor_text.ko: 동료를 돕는다. 도움받은 포켓몬이 쓰는 기술의 위력은 여느 때보다 커진다.

effect.short_effect: User and target swap items.
effect.effect:
User and target permanently swap held items.  Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything.  If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail.

If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail.

If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move.  This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used.  If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

flavor_text.en: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.
flavor_text.ko: 상대의 빈틈을 노려 자신과 상대가 지닌 물건을 바꿔치기한다.

effect.short_effect: Copies the target’s ability.
effect.effect:
User’s ability is replaced with the target’s until the user leaves the field.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

If the target has Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Stance Change, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

flavor_text.en: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's Ability.
flavor_text.ko: 상대의 역할을 하여 자신도 상대와 같은 특성으로 변화한다.

effect.short_effect: User will recover half its max HP at the end of the next turn.
effect.effect: At the end of the next turn, user will be healed for half its max HP.  If the user is switched out, its replacement will be healed instead for half of the user’s max HP.  If the user faints or is forcefully switched by Roar or Whirlwind, this effect will not activate.

flavor_text.en: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.
flavor_text.ko: 다음 턴에 자신 또는 교체한 포켓몬의 HP를 최대 HP의 절반만큼 회복한다.

effect.short_effect: Randomly selects and uses one of the trainer’s other Pokémon’s moves.
effect.effect:
Uses a move from another Pokémon in the user’s party, both selected at random.  Moves from fainted Pokémon can be used.  If there are no eligible Pokémon or moves, this move will fail.

This move will not select Assist, Chatter, Circle Throw, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dig, Dive, Dragon Tail, Endure, Feint, Fly Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Phantom Force Protect, Quick Guard, Roar Shadow Force, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wide Guard.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Metronome or Sleep Talk.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Prevents the user from leaving battle.  User regains 1/16 of its max HP every turn.
effect.effect:
Prevents the user from switching out.  User regains 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn.  If the user was immune to Ground attacks, it will now take normal damage from them.

Roar and Whirlwind will not affect the user.  The user cannot use Magnet Rise.

The user may still use U-turn to leave the field.

This effect can be passed with Baton Pass.

flavor_text.en: The user lays roots that restore its own HP every turn. Because the user is now rooted, it can't switch out.
flavor_text.ko: 대지에 뿌리를 박아 매 턴마다 자신의 HP를 회복한다. 뿌리 박고 있으므로 교체할 수 없다.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.
flavor_text.ko: 엄청난 힘을 발휘하여 상대를 공격한다. 자신의 공격과 방어가 떨어진다.

effect.short_effect: Reflects back the first effect move used on the user this turn.
effect.effect:
The first non-damaging move targeting the user this turn that inflicts major status effects, stat changes, or trapping effects will be reflected at its user.

Defog, Memento, and Teeter Dance are not reflected.

Attract, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Leech Seed, Swagger, Worry Seed, and Yawn are reflected.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

flavor_text.en: Moves like Leech Seed and moves that inflict status conditions are blocked by a barrier and reflected back to the user of those moves.
flavor_text.ko: 상대가 상태 이상이 되는 기술이나 씨뿌리기 등을 썼을 때 되받아친다.

effect.short_effect: User recovers the item it last used up.
effect.effect:
User recovers the last item consumed by the user or a Pokémon in its position on the field.  The item must be used again before it can be recovered by this move again.  If the user is holding an item, this move fails.

Items taken or given away by Covet, Knock Off, Switcheroo, Thief, or Trick may not be recovered.

effect.short_effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.  The user continues to use other moves during this time.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

flavor_text.en: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
flavor_text.ko: 세차게 불어대는 모래바람 속에 4-5턴 동안 상대를 가두어 공격한다.

effect.short_effect: Causes a one-hit KO.
effect.effect:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.  This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target.  If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target.  However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

flavor_text.en: The target faints instantly. This move is less likely to hit the target if used by Pokémon other than Ice types.
flavor_text.ko: 상대를 일격에 기절시킨다. 얼음타입 이외의 포켓몬이 사용하면 잘 맞지 않는다.

flavor_text.ko: 탁해진 물을 상대에게 발사하여 공격한다. 명중률을 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.

flavor_text.ko: 씨앗을 기세 좋게 상대에게 발사하여 공격한다. 2-5회 동안 연속으로 쓴다.

flavor_text.ko: 피부를 쇠처럼 단단하게 만듦으로써 자신의 방어를 크게 올린다.

effect.short_effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
effect.effect:
The target cannot switch out normally.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.  This effect ends when the user leaves the field.

The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell.

Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

flavor_text.en: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing.
flavor_text.ko: 양팔을 벌려 막아서서 상대의 도주로를 가로막아 도망칠 수 없게 한다.

effect.short_effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
effect.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

flavor_text.en: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.
flavor_text.ko: 큰 소리로 짖고 기합을 높여 자신과 같은 편의 공격을 올린다.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.en: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.
flavor_text.ko: 날카롭고 뾰족한 거대한 발톱으로 상대를 베어 갈라서 공격한다.

effect.short_effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

flavor_text.en: The user slams the target with the roots of an enormous tree. The user can't move on the next turn.
flavor_text.ko: 큰 나무로 상대를 힘껏 쳐서 공격한다. 다음 턴은 움직일 수 없게 된다.

effect.short_effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
effect.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

flavor_text.en: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.
flavor_text.ko: 몸에 힘을 담아 근육을 두껍게 해서 자신의 공격과 방어를 올린다.

effect.short_effect: User bounces high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User bounces high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.  Has a chance to paralyze the target.

During the immune turn, Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, and Twister still hit the user normally.  Gust and Twister also have double power against the user.

The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during the immune turn.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

flavor_text.en: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
flavor_text.ko: 하늘 높이 뛰어올라 2턴째에 상대를 공격한다. 마비 상태로 만들 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
flavor_text.ko: 진흙 덩어리를 상대에게 내던져서 공격한다. 동시에 상대의 스피드를 떨어뜨린다.

effect.short_effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.

flavor_text.en: The user hits the target with its tail. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also poison the target.
flavor_text.ko: 꼬리로 때린다. 독 상태로 만들 때가 있고 급소에도 맞기 쉽다.

effect.short_effect: Takes the target’s item.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item.  Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken.

Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect.

The target cannot recover its item with Recycle.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

flavor_text.en: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.
flavor_text.ko: 귀엽게 애교 부리며 상대에게 다가가 지니고 있는 도구를 뺏는다.

effect.short_effect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.  Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.  Has a chance to paralyze the target.

flavor_text.en: The user electrifies itself and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with paralysis.
flavor_text.ko: 전기를 한데 모아 돌진한다. 자신도 상당한 데미지를 입는다. 마비 상태로 만들 때가 있다.

flavor_text.en: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.
flavor_text.ko: 상대를 추적하는 이상한 잎사귀를 흩뿌린다. 공격은 반드시 명중한다.

effect.short_effect: Halves all Fire-type damage.
effect.effect: Fire moves inflict half damage, regardless of target.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

flavor_text.ko: 조용히 정신을 통일하고 마음을 가라앉혀서 자신의 특수공격과 특수방어를 올린다.

effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

flavor_text.ko: 잎사귀를 칼처럼 이용해 상대를 베어 공격한다. 급소에 맞기 쉽다.

effect.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage each.

effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to confuse the target.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.
flavor_text.ko: 물의 진동을 상대에게 가하여 공격한다. 상대를 혼란시킬 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Hits the target two turns later.
effect.effect:
Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one.  This move cannot score a critical hit.  If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead.  Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted.  No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn.

This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.

If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail.  However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection.

The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

flavor_text.en: Two turns after this move is used, a concentrated bundle of light blasts the target.
flavor_text.ko: 기술을 사용한 2턴 뒤에 무수한 빛의 다발이 상대를 공격한다.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Heals the user by half its max HP.
effect.effect: Heals the user for half its max HP.  If the user is Flying, its Flying type is ignored until the end of this turn.

flavor_text.en: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.
flavor_text.ko: 땅에 내려와 몸을 쉬게 한다. 최대 HP의 절반만큼 HP를 회복한다.

effect.short_effect: Disables moves and immunities that involve flying or levitating for five turns.
effect.effect:
For five turns (including this one), all immunities to Ground moves are disabled.  For the duration of this effect, the evasion of every Pokémon on the field is lowered by two stages.  Cancels the effects of Bounce, Fly, and Sky Drop.

Specifically, Flying Pokémon and those with Levitate or that have used Magnet Rise are no longer immune to Ground attacks, Arena Trap, Spikes, or Toxic Spikes.

Bounce, Fly, Sky Drop, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, and Splash cannot be used while this move is in effect.

*Bug*: If this move is used during a double or triple battle while Pokémon are under the effect of Sky Drop, Sky Drop’s effect is not correctly canceled on its target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely.  As Sky Drop prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

flavor_text.en: Enables Flying types or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves for five turns. Moves that involve flying can't be used.
flavor_text.ko: 5턴 동안 부유나 비행타입에 땅타입의 기술이 맞게 된다. 공중으로 나는 기술도 사용할 수 없다.

effect.short_effect: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.
effect.effect: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field.  A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves.  This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is sleeping, this move has double power, and the target wakes up.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage.

flavor_text.en: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.
flavor_text.ko: 강하고 무거운 주먹을 휘둘러 데미지를 준다. 자신의 스피드가 떨어진다.

effect.short_effect: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.

flavor_text.en: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.
flavor_text.ko: 몸을 고속으로 회전시켜 몸통박치기한다. 상대보다 스피드가 낮을수록 위력은 올라간다.

effect.short_effect: User faints.  Its replacement has its HP fully restored and any major status effect removed.
effect.effect: User faints.  Its replacement’s HP is fully restored, and any major status effect is removed.  If the replacement Pokémon is immediately fainted by a switch-in effect, the next replacement is healed by this move instead.

flavor_text.en: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status conditions cured.
flavor_text.ko: 자신은 기절하지만 교대하여 나오는 포켓몬의 상태 이상과 HP를 회복한다.

effect.short_effect: Has double power against Pokémon that have less than half their max HP remaining.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has less than half its max HP remaining, this move has double power.

flavor_text.en: This move's power is doubled if the target's HP is at half or less.
flavor_text.ko: 상대가 HP의 절반 정도 상처를 입고 있으면 기술의 위력이 2배가 된다.

effect.short_effect: Power and type depend on the held berry.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power and type are determined by the user’s held berry.  The berry is consumed.  If the user is not holding a berry, this move will fail.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Hits through Protect and Detect.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Removes the effects of Detect or Protect from the target before hitting.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

flavor_text.en: This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.
flavor_text.ko: 방어나 판별 등을 하고 있는 상대에게 공격할 수 있다. 방어 효과를 해제시킨다.

effect.short_effect: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately.

If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect.

If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
flavor_text.ko: 부리로 공격한다. 상대가 나무열매를 지니고 있을 때 먹어서 나무열매의 효과를 받을 수 있다.

effect.short_effect: For three turns, friendly Pokémon have doubled Speed.
effect.effect: For the next three turns, all Pokémon on the user’s side of the field have their original Speed doubled.  This effect remains if the user leaves the field.

flavor_text.en: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.
flavor_text.ko: 세차게 불어대는 바람의 소용돌이를 만들어 4턴 동안 같은 편 모두의 스피드를 올린다.

effect.short_effect: Raises one of a friendly Pokémon’s stats at random by two stages.
effect.effect:
Raises one of the target’s stats by two stages.  The raised stat is chosen at random from any stats that can be raised by two stages.  If no stat is eligible, this move will fail.

If the target has a Substitute, this move will have no effect, even if the user is the target.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

flavor_text.en: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.
flavor_text.ko: 경혈을 눌러 몸을 활성화시킨다. 능력 중 하나를 크게 올린다.

effect.short_effect: Strikes back at the last Pokémon to hit the user this turn with 1.5× the damage.
effect.effect: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a damaging move this turn.  Inflicts 1.5× the damage that move did to the user.  If there is no eligible target, this move will fail.  Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

flavor_text.en: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
flavor_text.ko: 기술을 쓰기 전에 마지막으로 받은 기술의 데미지를 늘려서 기술을 쓴 상대에게 돌려준다.

effect.short_effect: User must switch out after attacking.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party.  If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first.  If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain.  Ingrain’s effect will end.

flavor_text.en: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
flavor_text.ko: 공격한 뒤 굉장한 스피드로 돌아와서 교대 포켓몬과 교체한다.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

If a Pokémon under this effect uses Bug Bite or Pluck on a Pokémon holding a berry, the berry is destroyed but not used.  If a Pokémon under this effect uses Fling, it will fail.

This effect is passed by Baton Pass.

PP remaining | Power
------------ | ----:
4 or more    |    40
3            |    50
2            |    60
1            |    80
0            |   200

effect.short_effect: Scatters poisoned spikes, poisoning opposing Pokémon that switch in.

Pokémon otherwise immune to Ground moves are affected during Gravity.

If a Poison Pokémon not immune to Ground moves enters a field covered with poisoned spikes, the spikes are removed.

Rapid Spin will remove this effect from its user’s side of the field.  Defog will remove this effect from its target’s side of the field.

This move does not trigger Synchronize, unless the Pokémon with Synchronize was forced to enter the field by another effect such as Roar.

Pokémon entering the field due to Baton Pass are not affected by this effect.

flavor_text.en: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.

flavor_text.en: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of the target.
flavor_text.ko: 초능력으로 자신과 상대의 방어와 특수방어를 더해서 반으로 나눈다.

effect.short_effect: Averages Attack and Special Attack with the target.

Averages the user’s unmodified Attack with the target’s unmodified Attack; the value becomes the unmodified Attack for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Attack is averaged the same way.

This effect applies before any other persistent changes to unmodified Attack or Special Attack, such as Flower Gift during Sunny Day.

flavor_text.en: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.
flavor_text.ko: 초능력으로 자신과 상대의 공격과 특수공격을 더해서 반으로 나눈다.

effect.short_effect: All Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped for 5 turns.
effect.effect: For five turns (including this one), every Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped.

flavor_text.en: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.
flavor_text.ko: 이상한 공간을 만든다. 5턴 동안 모든 포켓몬의 방어와 특수방어가 바뀐다.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts damage based on the target’s Defense, not Special Defense.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.

flavor_text.en: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.
flavor_text.ko: 이상한 염력파를 실체화하여 상대를 공격한다. 물리적인 데미지를 준다.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts double damage if the target is Poisoned.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is poisoned, this move has double power.

flavor_text.en: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
flavor_text.ko: 특수한 독액을 끼얹는다. 독 상태의 상대에게는 위력이 2배가 된다.

effect.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.  Halves the user’s weight; this effect does not stack.

flavor_text.en: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
flavor_text.ko: 몸의 쓸모없는 부분을 깎는다. 자신의 스피드를 크게 올리고 체중도 가벼워진다.

effect.short_effect: Redirects the target’s single-target effects to the user for this turn.
effect.effect:
Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user.  If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target.

This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain.

If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

flavor_text.en: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opposing Pokémon aim only at the user.
flavor_text.ko: 안절부절못하게 하는 가루를 자신에게 뿌려서 주의를 끈다. 상대의 공격은 모두 자신에게 향한다.

effect.short_effect: Moves have 100% accuracy against the target for three turns.
effect.effect:
For three turns (including this one), moves used against the target have 100% accuracy, but the target is immune to Ground damage.  Accuracy of one-hit KO moves is exempt from this effect.

This effect is removed by Gravity.  If Gravity is already in effect, this move will fail.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Negates held items for five turns.

flavor_text.en: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.
flavor_text.ko: 이상한 공간을 만든다. 5턴 동안 모든 포켓몬의 도구의 효과가 사라진다.

effect.short_effect: Removes any immunity to Ground damage.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  Removes the target’s immunity to Ground-type damage.  This effect removes any existing Ground immunity due to Levitate, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, and causes the target’s Flying type to be ignored when it takes Ground damage.

If the target isn’t immune to Ground damage, this move will fail.

This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, and ends the effect of Bounce or Fly.

flavor_text.en: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. If the target is in the air, it will be knocked down to the ground.
flavor_text.ko: 돌이나 구슬을 던져서 날고 있는 상대를 공격한다. 맞은 상대는 땅에 떨어진다.

effect.short_effect: Always scores a critical hit.

flavor_text.ko: 강렬한 일격을 상대에게 날린다. 공격은 반드시 급소에 맞는다.

effect.short_effect: Deals splash damage to Pokémon next to the target.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to poison the target.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to poison the target.

flavor_text.en: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those it hits.

effect.short_effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.
effect.effect: Raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

flavor_text.en: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
flavor_text.ko: 신비롭고 아름다운 춤을 경쾌하게 춘다. 자신의 특수공격과 특수방어와 스피드를 올린다.

effect.short_effect: Power is higher when the user weighs more than the target, up to a maximum of 120.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  The greater the user’s weight compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 120.

User’s weight                    | Power
-------------------------------- | ----:
Up to 2× the target’s weight     |    40
Up to 3× the target’s weight     |    60
Up to 4× the target’s weight     |    80
Up to 5× the target’s weight     |   100
More than 5× the target’s weight |   120

flavor_text.en: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.
flavor_text.ko: 무거운 몸으로 상대에게 부딪쳐 공격한다. 자신이 상대보다 무거울수록 위력이 올라간다.

effect.short_effect: Hits any Pokémon that shares a type with the user.

User’s Speed                     | Power
-------------------------------- | ----:
Up to 2× the target’s Speed      |    60
Up to 3× the target’s Speed      |    80
Up to 4× the target’s Speed      |   120
More than 4× the target’s Speed  |   150

effect.short_effect: Changes the target’s type to Water.

flavor_text.ko: 많은 물을 끼얹어서 상대를 물타입으로 바꾼다.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Raises the user’s Speed by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Raises the user’s Speed by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 불꽃을 둘러 상대를 공격한다. 힘을 모아서 자신의 스피드를 올린다.

effect.short_effect: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.
effect.effect: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.

flavor_text.en: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.
flavor_text.ko: 똬리를 틀어서 집중한다. 자신의 공격과 방어와 명중률을 올린다.

effect.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

flavor_text.ko: 상대를 녹이는 액체를 토해내서 공격한다. 상대의 특수방어를 크게 떨어뜨린다.

flavor_text.ko: 상대의 힘을 이용한다. 싸우고 있는 상대의 공격이 높을수록 데미지가 올라간다.

The target will act next this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority.

flavor_text.en: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
flavor_text.ko: 상대의 행동을 도와서 자신이 행동한 뒤에 바로 움직일 수 있도록 한다.

effect.short_effect: Has double power if it’s used more than once per turn.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If Round has already been used this turn, this move’s power is doubled.  After this move is used, any other Pokémon using it this turn will immediately do so (in the order they would otherwise act), regardless of Speed or priority.  Pokémon using other moves will then continue to act as usual.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target with a song. If others use this move, they will act immediately after the initial user, and the power of their Rounds will be boosted.
flavor_text.ko: 노래로 상대를 공격한다. 함께 돌림노래를 하면 계속해서 쓸 수 있고 위력도 올라간다.

flavor_text.ko: 울리는 목소리로 상대를 공격한다. 매 턴 누군가 이 기술을 계속해서 쓰면 위력이 올라간다.

effect.short_effect: Removes all of the target’s stat modifiers.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.
flavor_text.ko: 특수한 진흙 덩어리를 상대에게 내던져서 공격한다. 능력 변화를 원래대로 돌린다.

effect.short_effect: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised.  Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power.  For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.
flavor_text.ko: 축적된 파워로 상대를 공격한다. 자신의 능력이 올라가 있는 만큼 위력이 오른다.

effect.short_effect: Prevents any priority moves from hitting friendly Pokémon this turn.
effect.effect:
Moves with priority greater than 0 will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn.  If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

flavor_text.en: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.
flavor_text.ko: 자신과 같은 편을 상대의 선제공격으로부터 지킨다.

effect.short_effect: User switches places with the friendly Pokémon opposite it.
effect.effect: User switches position on the field with the friendly Pokémon opposite it.  If the user is in the middle position in a triple battle, or there are no other friendly Pokémon, this move will fail.

flavor_text.en: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
flavor_text.ko: 이상한 힘으로 순간이동하여 자신과 같은 편의 위치를 바꾼다.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to burn the target.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks by shooting boiling hot water at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
flavor_text.ko: 뜨겁게 끓어오르는 물을 상대에게 발사해서 공격한다. 화상 상태로 만들 때가 있다.

effect.short_effect: Raises user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages.  Lower user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
effect.effect: Raises the user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages each.  Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

flavor_text.en: The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
flavor_text.ko: 껍질을 깨서 자신의 방어와 특수방어를 떨어뜨리지만 공격과 특수공격, 스피드를 크게 올린다.

effect.short_effect: Heals the target for half its max HP.
effect.effect: Heals the target for half its max HP.

flavor_text.en: The user emits a healing pulse that restores the target's HP by up to half its max HP.
flavor_text.ko: 치유파동을 날려서 최대 HP의 절반만큼 상대의 HP를 회복한다.

effect.short_effect: Has double power if the target has a major status ailment.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has a major status ailment, this move has double power.

flavor_text.en: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.
flavor_text.ko: 엎친 데 덮친 격으로 공격한다. 상태 이상인 상대에게 큰 데미지를 준다.

effect.short_effect: Carries the target high into the air, dodging all attacks against either, and drops it next turn.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User carries the target high into the air for one turn, during which no moves will hit either Pokémon and neither can act.  On the following turn, the user drops the target, inflicting damage and ending the effect.

If the target is Flying-type, this move will function as normal but inflict no damage.

Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, Twister, and Whirlwind can hit both the user and the target during this effect.  Gust and Twister will additionally have double power.

The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during this effect.

Either Pokémon may be hit during this effect if also under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

*Bug*: If Gravity is used during a double or triple battle while this move is in effect, this move is not correctly canceled on the target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely.  As this move prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.

effect.short_effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage and its Speed by two stages.
effect.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage and its Speed by two stages.

flavor_text.en: The user rotates its gears, boosting its Attack stat and sharply boosting its Speed stat.
flavor_text.ko: 톱니바퀴를 돌려서 자신의 공격을 올리는 것뿐만 아니라 스피드도 크게 올린다.

effect.short_effect: Ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random.

If the target is under the effect of Ingrain or Suction Cups, or it has a Substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out.  If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead.

flavor_text.en: The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

effect.short_effect: Destroys the target’s held berry.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target is holding a berry, it’s destroyed and cannot be used in response to this move.

flavor_text.en: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.
flavor_text.ko: 불꽃으로 상대를 공격한다. 상대가 나무열매 등을 지니고 있을 때 불태워서 쓸 수 없게 만든다.

effect.short_effect: Makes the target act last this turn.

flavor_text.en: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
flavor_text.ko: 상대를 억눌러서 행동의 순서를 마지막으로 만든다.

effect.short_effect: Has double power if the user has no held item.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the user has no held item, this move has double power.

flavor_text.en: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.
flavor_text.ko: 경쾌하게 상대를 공격한다. 자신이 도구를 지니고 있지 않을 때 큰 데미지를 준다.

effect.short_effect: User becomes the target’s type.
effect.effect: User’s type changes to match the target’s.

flavor_text.ko: 상대의 타입을 반사해서 자신도 똑같은 타입이 된다.
