flavor_text.en: The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move's power is boosted if an ally fainted in the previous turn.
flavor_text.ko: 쓰러진 같은 편의 원수를 갚는다. 앞 턴에서 같은 편이 쓰러지면 위력이 올라간다.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s remaining HP.  User faints.
effect.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s remaining HP.  User faints.

flavor_text.ko: 대지의 힘을 칼날로 바꿔 상대를 공격한다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

flavor_text.ko: 넓은 하늘에서 급속으로 강하하여 상대를 공격한다. 자신의 방어와 특수방어가 떨어진다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target by dropping out of the sky at high speed. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

effect.short_effect: Ignores and destroys protection effects.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Bypasses and removes any protection effect on the target.

flavor_text.ko: 많은 팔로 방어와 판별 등을 무시하는 연속 공격이다. 자신의 방어가 떨어진다.
flavor_text.en: Using its many arms, the user unleashes a barrage of attacks that ignore the effects of moves like Protect and Detect. This also lowers the user's Defense stat.

effect.short_effect: Heals the user for ½ its max HP, or ⅔ during a sandstorm.
effect.effect: Heals the user for ½ its max HP.  During a Sandstorm, the healing is increased to ⅔.

flavor_text.en: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP. It regains more HP in a sandstorm.
flavor_text.ko: 자신의 최대 HP 절반을 회복한다. 모래바람일 때는 많이 회복한다.

effect.short_effect: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field.

flavor_text.ko: 위력이 높은 기술이지만 배틀에 나가서 바로 쓰지 않으면 성공할 수 없다.
flavor_text.en: Although this move has great power, it works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

effect.short_effect: Grants the user protection for the rest of the turn and poisons any Pokémon that tries to use a contact move on it.
effect.effect: Grants the user protection for the rest of the turn.  If a Pokémon attempts to use a move that makes contact with the user, that Pokémon will be poisoned.  This move’s chance of success halves every time it’s used consecutively with any other protection move.

flavor_text.ko: 상대의 공격을 막음과 동시에 접촉한 상대에게 독을 퍼뜨린다.
flavor_text.en: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.

effect.short_effect: Traps the target.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Traps the target.

flavor_text.ko: 공격과 동시에 상대의 그림자를 꿰매 도망칠 수 없게 한다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target's shadow to the ground to prevent the target from fleeing.

effect.short_effect: Ignores the target’s stat modifiers.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion.

flavor_text.ko: 양팔을 돌려 상대에게 부딪친다. 상대의 능력 변화에 상관없이 데미지를 준다.
flavor_text.en: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.

effect.short_effect: Cures the target of burns.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has a burn and takes damage from this move, its burn is healed.

flavor_text.ko: 노래 부르는 것으로 많은 벌룬을 방출한다. 기술에 맞으면 화상이 낫는다.
flavor_text.en: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be cured by the touch of these bubbles.

effect.short_effect: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 강하고 무거운 주먹을 휘둘러 데미지를 준다. 자신의 스피드가 떨어진다.
flavor_text.en: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.

effect.short_effect: Heals the target for ½ its max HP, or ⅔ on Grassy Terrain.
effect.effect: Heals the target for ½ its max HP.  If Grassy Terrain is in effect, heals for ⅔ instead.

flavor_text.ko: 최대 HP의 절반만큼 상대의 HP를 회복한다. 그래스필드일 때 효과가 올라간다.
flavor_text.en: The user restores the target's HP by up to half its max HP. More HP is restored when the ground is Grassy Terrain.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 온몸을 써서 상대에게 맹렬히 어택한다.
flavor_text.en: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

effect.short_effect: Heals the user by the target’s current Attack stat and lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
effect.effect:
Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.  Heals the user by the target’s current Attack, including modifiers, but not including this move’s Attack-lowering effect.

If the target’s Attack is already at -6, this move will fail.  In any other situation that would prevent a stat modification, the healing will still succeed.

flavor_text.ko: 상대 공격력과 동일하게 자신의 HP를 회복한다. 그리고 상대의 공격을 떨어뜨린다.
flavor_text.en: The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. It then lowers the target's Attack stat.

effect.short_effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  User charges for one turn before attacking.

During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

flavor_text.ko: 1턴째에 빛을 가득 모아 2턴째에 그 힘을 검에 담아 공격한다.
flavor_text.en: The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light's energy and attacks on the next turn.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 잎을 상대에 맞춰 공격한다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

effect.short_effect: Forces the target’s opponents to aim at the target for the rest of the turn.
effect.effect: For the duration of the turn, if the target is also a valid target for a move used by one of its opponents, that move will target it instead.

flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.
flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

effect.short_effect: Poisons the target and lowers its Speed by one stage.
effect.effect: Poisons the target and lowers its Speed by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 독이 섞인 실을 뿜어낸다. 상대를 독 상태로 만들고 스피드를 떨어뜨린다.
flavor_text.en: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.

effect.short_effect: Guarantees a critical hit with the user’s next move.
effect.effect: The user’s next move will result in a critical hit.

flavor_text.ko: 정신을 집중해서 다음 공격을 반드시 급소에 맞춘다.
flavor_text.en: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.

effect.short_effect: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.
effect.effect: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 기어를 넣는 것으로 특성 플러스와 마이너스의 공격과 특수공격이 올라간다.
flavor_text.en: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.

effect.short_effect: Prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Silences the target for two turns, preventing it from using any sound-based moves.

flavor_text.ko: 이 기술에 맞은 상대는 지옥의 고통 때문에 2턴 동안 소리 기술을 낼 수 없다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.

effect.short_effect: Damages opponents, but heals allies for 50% of their max HP.
effect.effect: If the target is an opponent, inflicts regular damage.  If the target is an ally, heals the target for 50% of its max HP.

flavor_text.ko: 상대에게는 폭발하는 경단을 사용하여 공격한다. 같은 편에게는 회복하는 경단을 준다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

effect.short_effect: Traps the target.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Traps the target.

flavor_text.ko: 앵커를 상대에게 휘감아서 공격한다. 상대는 도망칠 수 없게 된다.
flavor_text.en: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee.

effect.short_effect: Protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and increases the power of their  Psychic moves by 50%.
effect.effect:
Changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain for 5 turns.  Overrides Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, and Misty Terrain.

All Pokémon on the ground are immune to moves with priority greater than 0.  (Moves that target the field rather than individual Pokémon, such as Spikes, are not affected.)  Additionally, when a Pokémon on the ground uses a Psychic-type move, that move’s power is increased to 1.5×.

If a Pokémon is holding a Terrain Extender when creating Psychic Terrain (by any means), the effect lasts for 8 turns instead of 5.

flavor_text.ko: 5턴 동안 땅에 있으면 선제공격을 받지 않는다. 에스퍼타입의 위력이 올라간다.
flavor_text.en: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 전력으로 상대에게 덤벼들며 공격한다. 상대의 공격을 떨어뜨린다.
flavor_text.en: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 불타는 채찍으로 상대를 친다. 공격을 받은 상대는 방어가 떨어진다.
flavor_text.en: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

effect.short_effect: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised.  Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power.  For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.

flavor_text.ko: 자신의 강함을 뻐기고 공격한다. 자신의 능력이 올라가 있는 만큼 위력이 오른다.
flavor_text.en: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

effect.short_effect: Removes the user’s Fire type after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Removes the user’s Fire type after damage calculation.  If the user is not Fire-type, this move will fail.

flavor_text.ko: 전신의 불꽃을 모두 태워서 큰 데미지를 준다. 자신의 불꽃타입이 없어진다.
flavor_text.en: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.

effect.short_effect: Exchanges the user’s Speed with the target’s.
effect.effect: Exchanges the original Speed stats of the user and target.

flavor_text.ko: 상대의 스피드와 자신의 스피드를 교체한다.
flavor_text.en: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

effect.short_effect: Never misses.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

flavor_text.ko: 뾰족한 뿔로 상대를 꿰찔러서 공격한다. 공격은 반드시 명중한다.
flavor_text.en: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

effect.short_effect: Cures the target of a major status ailment and heals the user for 50% of its max HP.
effect.effect: Cures the target of its major status ailment and heals the user for 50% of its max HP.  If the target has no major status ailment, this move will fail.

flavor_text.ko: 상대의 상태 이상을 회복한다. 회복하면 자신은 HP를 회복할 수 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user heals the target’s status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user’s own HP.

effect.short_effect: Has the same type as the user.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  This move’s type matches the user’s first type, if any; otherwise, it’s typeless.

flavor_text.ko: 전력으로 춤추며 공격한다. 이 기술의 타입은 자신의 타입과 같아진다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target by dancing with all its might. This move becomes the same type as the user's type.

effect.short_effect: Nullifies the target’s ability if it moves earlier.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the target has already moved this turn, its ability is nullified.

flavor_text.ko: 데미지를 준 상대가 이미 행동을 끝냈다면 상대의 특성을 없애버린다.
flavor_text.en: If the Pokémon the user has inflicted damage on have already used their moves, this move eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 남쪽 나라에서 유래된 뜨거운 킥을 상대에게 날린다. 상대의 공격을 떨어뜨린다.
flavor_text.en: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

effect.short_effect: Forces the target to repeat its last used move.
effect.effect: The target immediately uses its most recently-used move.  This is independent of the target’s normal action for the turn (i.e., it may end up moving twice), but otherwise functions as usual, including deduction of PP.  This effect works for disabled moves and ignores Torment.

flavor_text.ko: 상대에게 지시하여 상대가 쓴 기술을 다시 한번 쓰게 할 수 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user instructs the target to reuse the move last used by the target.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts a burn on any Pokémon that makes contact before the attack.
effect.effect: Begins charging at the start of the turn, then attacks as normal.  Any Pokémon that makes contact with the user while charging is burned.  The charging is not affected by accuracy, sleep, paralysis, or any other effect that would interfere with a move.

flavor_text.ko: 먼저 부리를 가열시킨 다음 공격을 날린다. 가열 중에 만지면 화상을 입는다.
flavor_text.en: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the user while it's heating up its beak results in a burn.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the user’s Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the user’s Defense by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 전신의 비늘을 비벼서 큰 소리를 내 공격한다. 공격 후 자신의 방어가 떨어진다.
flavor_text.en: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user's Defense stat is lowered after the attack.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 몸을 해머처럼 써서 상대를 덮쳐 데미지를 준다.
flavor_text.en: The user wields its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 자신의 몸을 세차게 휘둘러서 상대에게 데미지를 준다.
flavor_text.en: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

effect.short_effect: Reduces damage five turns, but must be used during hail.
effect.effect:
Places the Aurora Veil effect on the user’s side of the field for the next 5 turns.  If the weather is not Hail, or the weather is disabled by the effects of Cloud Nine or Air Lock, this move will fail.

Any regular damage dealt to an affected Pokémon is reduced by ½.  (If there are multiple Pokémon on the affected field, the reduction is ⅓.)

flavor_text.ko: 5턴 동안 물리와 특수 기술의 데미지를 약하게 한다. 싸라기눈일 때만 쓸 수 있다.
flavor_text.en: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only when it is snowing.

effect.short_effect: Only inflicts damage if the user was hit by a physical move this turn.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  If the user was not yet hit by an opponent’s physical move this turn, this move will fail.

flavor_text.ko: 껍질의 트랩을 설치한다. 상대가 물리 기술을 쓰면 폭발해서 데미지를 준다.
flavor_text.en: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode and inflict damage on opposing Pokémon.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

flavor_text.ko: 강력한 빔을 발산한 후 자신의 특수공격이 크게 떨어진다.
flavor_text.en: The user unleashes a strong beam. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

effect.short_effect: Destroys Reflect and Light Screen.
effect.effect: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 사이코 파워로 물어서 상대를 공격한다. 빛의장막이나 리플렉터도 파괴할 수 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks by biting the target with its psychic capabilities. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

effect.short_effect: Has double power if the user’s last move failed.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Power is doubled if the user’s last move failed for any reason (i.e., produced the message "But it failed!") or was ineffective due to types.

flavor_text.ko: 분함을 발판 삼아 공격한다. 앞 턴에서 기술이 빗나갔다면 위력이 배가 된다.
flavor_text.en: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 영혼이 머물고 있는 뼈로 상대를 세게 때려서 공격한다. 상대의 방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks by beating the target with a bone that contains a spirit. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 재빠른 스피드로 상대에게 부딪쳐서 공격한다. 반드시 선제공격할 수 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 물의 힘으로 상대에게 부딪쳐서 공격한다. 상대의 방어를 떨어뜨릴 때가 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

effect.short_effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

flavor_text.ko: 프리즘의 힘으로 강력한 광선을 발사한다. 다음 턴은 움직일 수 없다.
flavor_text.en: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.

effect.short_effect: Steals the target’s stat increases, then inflicts damage.
effect.effect: Steals the target’s stat increases, then inflicts regular damage.  Will not steal stat increases that would put any of the user’s stats at more than +6; any excess is left on the target.  Stolen increases are affected by abilities as normal.

flavor_text.ko: 상대의 그림자에 숨어들어 상대의 능력이 올라가는 것을 뺏어 공격한다.
flavor_text.en: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.

effect.short_effect: Cannot be disrupted by abilities.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move.  In particular, it hits through Disguise

flavor_text.ko: 유성 같은 기세로 돌진한다. 상대의 특성을 무시하고 공격할 수 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.

effect.short_effect: Cannot be disrupted by abilities.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move.  In particular, it hits through Disguise

flavor_text.ko: 괴상한 광선을 쏘아 공격한다. 상대의 특성을 무시하고 공격할 수 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.
effect.effect: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

flavor_text.ko: 눈물을 그렁그렁거려 상대의 전의를 상실하게 한다. 상대의 공격과 특수공격이 떨어진다.
flavor_text.en: The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to make the target flinch.

flavor_text.ko: 상대에게 부딪쳐 강력한 전기를 날려서 찌리리따끔따끔하게 만든다. 상대를 풀죽게 만들 때가 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user crashes into the target, delivering a powerful electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts damage equal to half the target’s HP.
effect.effect: Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP.

flavor_text.ko: 자연의 분노를 상대에게 부딪친다. 상대의 HP는 절반이 된다.
flavor_text.en: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target’s HP.

effect.short_effect: If the user is holding a appropriate plate or drive, the damage inflicted will match it.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item.

Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

flavor_text.ko: 높은 에너지를 둘러싸 상대에게 부딪쳐 공격한다. 메모리에 따라 타입이 바뀐다.
flavor_text.en: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. The memory held determines the move’s type.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up.
effect.effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

flavor_text.ko: 자신의 머리를 폭발시켜 주위의 모든 것을 공격한다. 자신도 데미지를 받는다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks everything around it by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.

effect.short_effect: After inflicting damage, causes all Normal-type moves to become Electric-type for the remainder of the turn.
effect.effect: After inflicting damage, all Normal-type moves become Electric-type for the remainder of the turn, including status moves. This effect is applied after move type-changing abilities, such as Pixilate and Normalize.

flavor_text.ko: 전기를 두른 주먹으로 공격한다. 노말타입 기술을 전기타입으로 바꿔버린다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This move changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 빛의 기둥으로 공격한다. 공격과 특수공격을 비교해서 높은 쪽으로 데미지를 준다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 사용할 수 없는 기술입니다. 다시 배우게 할 수 없지만 기술을 잊게 하는 것을 권장합니다.
flavor_text.en: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

effect.short_effect: Hits twice in one turn.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Hits twice in one turn.

flavor_text.ko: 가슴의 너트를 축으로 회전시켜 2번 연속 팔로 힘껏 친다. 상대를 풀죽게 만들 때가 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may also make the target flinch.

effect.short_effect: The user unleashes a strong beam from its core. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
effect.effect: The user unleashes a strong beam from its core. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

flavor_text.ko: 코어에서 빔을 발사해서 공격한다. 상대가 다이맥스 중이면 데미지가 2배가 된다.
flavor_text.en: The user condenses energy within its body and unleashes that energy from its core to inflict damage.

effect.short_effect: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.
effect.effect: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

flavor_text.ko: 상대의 기술을 끌어모으는 특성이나 기술의 영향을 무시하고 선택한 상대를 공격할 수 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

effect.short_effect: Seeds the target after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then (if successful) sets Leech Seed on the target.

flavor_text.ko: 어느 한쪽이 기절할 때까지 교체할 수 없게 된다. 한쪽의 포켓몬이 없어지면 효과가 사라진다.
flavor_text.en: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.

effect.short_effect: Cures the entire party of major status effects after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then (if successful) removes major status effects from every Pokémon in the user’s party.

flavor_text.ko: 지니고 있는 나무열매를 먹고 방어를 크게 올린다.
flavor_text.en: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.

effect.short_effect: Hits twice in one turn, with a chance to make the target flinch.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Hits twice in one turn, with a chance to make the target flinch.

flavor_text.ko: 자신의 모든 능력이 올라가지만 교체하거나 도망칠 수 없게 된다.
flavor_text.en: This move boosts all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.

flavor_text.ko: 끈적끈적한 타르를 날려서 상대의 스피드를 떨어뜨린다. 상대는 불꽃이 약점이 된다.
flavor_text.en: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target's Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.

flavor_text.ko: 마법가루를 날려서 상대를 에스퍼타입으로 바꾼다.
flavor_text.en: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target's type to Psychic.

flavor_text.ko: 드라꼰으로 2번 공격한다. 상대가 2마리일 때는 각각 1번씩 공격한다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.

flavor_text.ko: 다과회를 열어서 배틀에 나와 있는 포켓몬이 각각 지니고 있는 나무열매를 먹는다.
flavor_text.en: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

flavor_text.ko: 상대를 도망칠 수 없게 한다. 굳히기에 당한 상대는 매 턴 방어와 특수방어가 떨어진다.
flavor_text.en: The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. This move also lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def every turn.

flavor_text.ko: 전기를 두른 부리로 찌른다. 상대보다 먼저 공격하면 기술의 위력은 2배가 된다.
flavor_text.en: The user stabs the target with its electrified beak. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.

flavor_text.ko: 단단한 아가미로 문다. 상대보다 먼저 공격하면 기술의 위력은 2배가 된다.
flavor_text.en: The user rends the target with its hard gills. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.

flavor_text.ko: 이상한 힘으로 서로의 필드 효과를 교체한다.
flavor_text.en: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

flavor_text.ko: 자신의 HP를 조금 깎아서 모든 능력을 올린다.
flavor_text.en: The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.

flavor_text.ko: 몸을 부딪쳐서 공격한다. 방어가 높을수록 주는 데미지가 올라간다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

flavor_text.ko: 데코레이션을 해서 상대의 공격과 특수공격을 크게 올린다.
flavor_text.en: The user sharply boosts the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 드럼의 뿌리를 연주로 조종해서 공격하는 것으로 상대의 스피드를 떨어뜨린다.
flavor_text.en: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

effect.short_effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
effect.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.  For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.  The user continues to use other moves during this time.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

flavor_text.ko: 집게덫으로 붙잡은 뒤 4-5턴 동안 상대를 끼워서 공격한다.
flavor_text.en: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to burn the target.

flavor_text.ko: 작은 돌을 태운 불꽃의 공으로 상대를 공격한다. 화상 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

flavor_text.ko: 볼주머니에 저장해둔 에너지로 공격하고 자신의 스피드를 올린다. 모르페코의 모습에 따라 타입이 바뀐다.
flavor_text.en: Morpeko attacks and boosts its Speed stat with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 강인한 꼬리를 세차게 휘둘러서 상대를 공격한다. 상대의 공격을 떨어뜨린다.
flavor_text.en: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 날카롭고 뾰족한 가지로 상대를 찔러서 공격한다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

flavor_text.ko: 기타나 베이스를 쳐서 큰 울림과 강한 진동을 상대에게 전달하여 공격한다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

flavor_text.ko: 새콤한 사과에서 만들어 낸 산성 액체로 공격한다. 상대의 특수방어를 떨어뜨린다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

effect.short_effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 높은 곳에서 사과를 떨어뜨려서 데미지를 준다. 상대의 방어를 떨어뜨린다.
flavor_text.en: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

flavor_text.ko: 맞으면 기가 꺾여버릴 것 같은 기세로 공격한다. 상대의 특수공격을 떨어뜨린다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

effect.short_effect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Has a chance to confuse the target.

flavor_text.ko: 연기를 분출해서 상대를 공격한다. 혼란시킬 때가 있다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.

flavor_text.ko: 신비한 물을 흩뿌려서 자신과 배틀에 나와 있는 같은 편의 HP를 회복한다.
flavor_text.en: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

flavor_text.ko: 상대의 공격을 전혀 받지 않는다. 연속으로 쓰면 실패하기 쉽다. 접촉한 상대의 방어를 크게 떨어뜨린다.
flavor_text.en: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession. Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker’s Defense stat.

effect.short_effect: Never misses.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

flavor_text.ko: 고개를 숙이는 척하면서 흐트러진 머리카락으로 찌른다. 공격은 반드시 명중한다.
flavor_text.en: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

effect.short_effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

flavor_text.ko: 굵은 줄기를 휘둘러서 공격한다. 단 자신도 비틀거리기 때문에 다음 턴은 움직일 수 없다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can’t move on the next turn, because the force of this move makes it stagger.

effect.short_effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

flavor_text.ko: 본래의 모습이 된 무한다이노 최대의 공격. 다음 턴은 움직일 수 없다.
flavor_text.en: This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original form. The user can’t move on the next turn.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up.
effect.effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

flavor_text.ko: 전신에서 끌어모은 강철을 빔으로 바꿔 세차게 발사한다. 자신도 데미지를 받는다.
flavor_text.en: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 사이코 파워로 상대를 공격한다. 사이코필드일 때는 위력이 오르며 모든 상대에게 데미지를 준다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 필드를 파괴하면서 공격한다. 필드가 어떤 상태로든 변해 있지 않은 경우 기술은 실패한다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.

effect.short_effect: Boosts the user’s Speed and lowers their Defense by one stage after inflicting damage two to five times in a row.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage two to five times in a row, raising the user’s Speed and lowering the user’s Defense by one stage each upon last hit.

flavor_text.ko: 비늘을 쏘아서 공격한다. 2-5회 동안 연속으로 쓴다. 스피드가 올라가지만 방어가 떨어진다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 1턴째에 우주의 힘을 모아서 특수공격을 올리고 2턴째에 상대를 공격한다.
flavor_text.en: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 물리와 특수 중 더 많은 데미지를 줄 수 있는 능력으로 공격한다. 독 상태로 만들 때가 있다.
flavor_text.en: This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This may also poison the target.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 자신의 주위에 있는 모두를 공격하지만 사용하면 기절한다. 미스트필드일 때 위력이 올라간다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is boosted on Misty Terrain.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 지면에 미끄러지듯 상대를 공격한다. 그래스필드일 때 반드시 선제공격할 수 있다.
flavor_text.en: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

effect.short_effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 지면에서 올라오는 전격으로 공격한다. 상대가 일렉트릭필드 위에 있을 때 기술의 위력이 2배가 된다.

effect.effect: Inflicts regular damage.

flavor_text.ko: 강력한 사이코 파워로 공격한다. 상대가 마지막으로 사용한 기술의 PP를 3만큼 줄인다.
flavor_text.en: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.
The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.
Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.
The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.
The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.
The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.
The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.
The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.
The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This may also make the target flinch.
The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.
The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.
The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.
The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.
The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.
The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.
The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.
The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave them with a burn.
The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.
The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.
The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.
The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.
The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.
The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.
The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.
The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.
The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.
The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.
The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.
The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.
The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.
The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.
The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.
The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.
The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.
The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.
The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.
The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.
The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.
The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.
The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.
The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.
The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.
The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.
The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.
The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.
The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.
The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.
The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.
The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.
The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.
The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.
With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.
The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.
The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.
This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.
The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.
The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.
The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.
Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.
The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.
The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
